top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, mature discovery arc: the physiology of GLP-1 and identification of its active peptide form, with glucose-dependent insulinotropic and satiety actions, confirmed by large randomized trials of glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. A discovery citation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov keeps the prize on physiology and is defensible despite the open question of the third name and Mojsov's contested priority; that attribution weakness does not outweigh the achievement, so awarding it is clearly preferable to no award.
